faqs.q: Sec. 102-71. - Unauthorized use of water system.
faqs.a:
(a)
It is unlawful for any person to connect to, use, or take any water from the city
               water system without a valid permit and prior payment of all required fees and user
               charges. Unauthorized use shall include, but shall not be limited to, the use or acquisition
               of water from fire hydrants, illegal connections to the water system, and straight-through
               pipes at the water meter pit. The city may terminate a person's water service for
               an unauthorized use of the water system.
(b)
The charge for unauthorized use of water is a special charge of $100.00 for and is
               in addition to any other charge by the city for water service.
(c)
In billing the party responsible for water used without authorization, the city may
               use any reasonable method to determine the amount of water so used including, but
               not limited to, previous account history.
(Code 1981, § 33-43.1; Ord. No. 2574, § 1, 11-21-1988; Ord. No. 2671, §§ 6, 7, 10-16-1989;
               Ord. No. 2931, § 4, 10-19-1992; Ord. No. 3403, § 12, 10-20-1997)
